rulingAcknowledged.ruling: Raise the per-session input ceiling max-model-input-tokens-total (GuidedSessionProperties default and fallback; contracts/v3/limits.schema.json maxModelInputTokensTotal maximum = default) from 128000 to 262144. Prompt, reservation accounting, test flow and the test's use of production session defaults are unchanged.

rationale: The bound was provisional by its own terms. consensus-plan §8 lists it under 'Proposed initial configurable bounds (to verify in the feasibility phase, not measured capacity claims)'. The OBS-005 joined fixture is that verification, and the bound fails it.

The failure comes from required product content, not a defect. Before OBS-007 the controlled 3-step clarify-plus-restart flow already reserved 121,589 of 128,000 (95.0%). The OBS-007 secret-login output contract (+701 bytes plus the v3 response schema) is sent on every request. Now 7 proposals reserve 112,277 and the 8th does not fit (projected about 128,320). Every GA login session pays this cost.

The rejected alternatives are worse product outcomes. Refunds or estimator changes would reverse translation-design's retain/no-refund audit model. A conditional prompt would create two contract variants against ADR-SC-005 D-A and still fail on secret sessions. Re-baselining the flow or a test-only override would weaken the OBS-005 oracle or hide the inadequacy.

Cost is bounded. Per-session worst-case reserved input rises x2.048 (128,000 -> 262,144 bytes-as-tokens). That is a ceiling, not expected spend; flows that already fit cost the same. Bytes overstate provider tokens (inference, about 3-4 bytes per token for English/JSON; not measured).

The USD 500 ceiling is unaffected. It is the STUDIO-OBSERVED wave's development/coordinator spend authorization (docs/stories/STUDIO-OBSERVED/README.md:34,79) and is not derived from per-session reservations. OBS-009 AC-7 still records budget admission against it before the first real-provider call.

Aggregate production spend is governed by STUDIO-OBS-014 AC-8 (per-CSI concurrent-session limit and persisted per-CSI daily token budget, 'in addition to the per-session budgets'), whatever the per-session ceiling is.
conditionsOfAck: C-1: 262,144 is recorded as a byte-denominated reservation bound checked only on fixtures, NOT a measured real-workload capacity. It must be recalibrated from STUDIO-OBS-009 AC-7 real-model runs, input and output totals together (F-1). Any later bound change returns to @architect with @pm acknowledgement.

C-2: The architect's stop conditions SC-1..SC-6 stand unchanged. In particular SC-2: if the joined flow's final reserved modelInputTokens exceeds 131,072, report to @architect before crediting. SC-4: the regeneration diff is limited to maxModelInputTokensTotal maximum/default plus the enumerated fixture snapshots.

C-3: The three names count green only after the 012A lanes apply the exact changes in the ruling and @qa confirms the re-expressed literals keep their relation to the ceiling. This ACK does not itself credit any test.

C-4: Reliance on OBS-014 AC-8 as the production spend governor is prospective. OBS-014 is Status Ready (not Done) on 2026-10-13. Under the existing order (007 -> 012A -> 012B/013/014 -> 015 -> 008 -> 009 -> pilot), no real-provider pilot runs before OBS-014 is Done. This ACK does not relax that order.
